follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

notes: Searched all three supplied source texts for analysis-set definitions. The abstracts report 795 analysed of 800 randomised but do not define ITT, mITT, per-protocol, safety, or available-case analyses. Despite the brief, no held_local full-text source is included. ICU admission for severe CAP narrows the population within the question's hospitalised adults; no entry criterion establishes a population outside it. Mortality is assessed at day 28; 8 or 14 days describes treatment duration.
